name: gmail_read
description: Reads recent or matching emails from Gmail — sender, subject, date, and a short preview. Read-only. Use to check the inbox, search emails, or see recent messages. Pass a message_id to read one full message, or a position to read one from the last list Aegon showed.

query.description: Optional Gmail search query, e.g. 'from:john', 'is:unread'. Empty for recent emails.

max_results.description: How many emails to list (default 5, max 20).

message_id.description: If set, reads the full body of this one message instead of listing.

position.description: 1-based position referring to the last email list Aegon showed. Use this when Sir says 'read the first email', 'who is the second from', etc.
